name: Valkyrie no Souretsu
source:
A man with twisted impulses to capture, confine, rape and cause weeping misery to magical heroines is enabled by the power of a strange being. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE115512.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个有着扭曲冲动的男人想要捕获、囚禁、强奸并给魔法女主角造成哭泣的痛苦，而这个奇怪的存在的力量使他得以实现。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE115512.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
